proposals.before: Mapu yashu of a certain mirli xinjun
proposals.after: Mapu; yashu; a certain mirli; xinjun
proposals.reason: The Chinese lists four parallel tribal offices (mapu, yashu, mirli, xinjun), but the literal English fuses them into one ungrammatical chain of possession.

proposals.before: Founding ancestor Nieli focused on farming and crafts, and Taizu pressed the same priorities, though herding, hunting, and fishing stayed central to Khitan life.
proposals.after: Founding ancestor Nieli devoted himself to farming and crafts, and Taizu was especially earnest about the same, though herding, hunting, and fishing remained established custom.
proposals.reason: The idiomatic English inserts 'Khitan,' which is not in the Chinese, and underplays 尤拳拳焉 relative to the literal rendering.

proposals.before: Bird-or-beast chief overseer, bird supervisor, beast supervisor, and Deer Xiangwen Office
proposals.after: Chief overseer of a given bird or beast, supervisor of a given bird, supervisor of a given beast, and the Deer Xiangwen Office
proposals.reason: 監某鳥獸都監, 監某鳥, and 監某獸 are three sequential office titles (chief overseer of a given bird or beast; bird supervisor; beast supervisor), not a fused 'Bird-or-beast chief overseer' phrase.
Chinese 大惕隱司 names the Great Tixin Office; the idiomatic English incorrectly copies the cross-reference of the following sentence.

proposals.before: Vice overall deployment, chief overseer, and assessor—commandery titles in summary:
proposals.after: Vice overall deployment, chief overseer, and assessor—commander titles in summary:
proposals.reason: 指揮使 are army commander titles, not commanderies; the following unit already renders 都指揮使 as commander-in-chief.

proposals.before: Vice Overall Deployment of a certain military and horse; Chief Overseer of a certain military and horse; Assessor of a certain overall deployment—General list of commandery titles:
proposals.after: Vice Overall Deployment of a certain military and horse; Chief Overseer of a certain military and horse; Assessor of a certain overall deployment—General list of commander titles:
proposals.reason: 指揮使職名總目 is a list of commander titles, not commandery titles.

proposals.before: It had a military overall superintendent and an officer directing southern frontier affairs.
proposals.after: Nanjing Infantry and Cavalry Commander-in-Chief Office.
proposals.reason: Chinese names the Nanjing cavalry-and-infantry commander-in-chief office; the English repeats the previous sentence about the overall superintendent.

proposals.before: There is a Military and Horse Overall Superintendent; there is an officer who overall directs Southern Face frontier affairs.
proposals.after: Nanjing Infantry and Cavalry Commander-in-Chief Office.
proposals.reason: Literal English copies s0199 instead of 南京馬步軍都指揮使司.

proposals.before: The above Northwest Circuit offices controlled frontier peoples.
proposals.after: The above Northwest Circuit offices controlled the various states.
proposals.reason: Chinese 諸國 means the various states/countries, not ethnic frontier peoples.

proposals.before: North, Northwest, Qisu River, and Chengqu Li Zubu State Great King Offices
proposals.after: North, Northwest, Qisu River, and Chengqu Li State Great King Offices
proposals.reason: Chinese 城屈裏國大王府 names Chengqu Li as its own state office; the idiomatic rendering wrongly inserts Zubu into that last item.

proposals.before: In the first year of Shengzong Tonghe the Huali Division requested that henceforth xiangwen be selected from within the division and not be permitted.
proposals.after: In the first year of Shengzong Tonghe the Huali Division requested that henceforth xiangwen be selected from within the division's own people; this was not permitted.
proposals.reason: 不許 is the court's refusal of the petition, not part of the requested rule; the current literal fuses the denial into the request.

decisions.reason: The unpunctuated string is four coordinate offices—麻普, 牙書, 某彌裏, 辛袞—matching the preceding tribal-title list; the current literal wrongly makes them one possessive chain.
究心 and 尤拳拳焉 mark Nieli’s and Taizu’s earnest attention to farming and crafts; 固俗尚也 is established custom, not ‘Khitan life,’ which the current idiomatic invents.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 遼始祖涅裏究心農工之事，太祖尤拳拳焉，畜牧畋漁，固俗尚也。

decisions.reason: The unit lists four titles in sequence—監某鳥獸都監, 監某鳥, 監某獸, 監鹿詳穩司—each 某 marking a given bird or beast; the current phrasing drops that placeholder and fuses the first title.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 監某鳥獸都監監某鳥監某獸監鹿詳穩司

decisions.reason: s0166 is only 大惕隱司; 見帳官 belongs to the next unit, so the current idiomatic cross-reference is a copy error.
諸指揮使職名總目 introduces commander (指揮使) titles, not commanderies; s0176 already renders 都指揮使 as commander-in-chief.
The same heading 諸指揮使職名總目 is a general list of commander titles; ‘commandery’ misreads 指揮使 as a territorial commandery.
The Chinese names 南京馬步軍都指揮使司; the current idiomatic repeats offices from s0199 instead of this Nanjing cavalry-and-infantry commander-in-chief office.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 南京馬步軍都指揮使司。

decisions.reason: The literal likewise copies s0199 (兵馬都總管 / 總領南面邊事) rather than translating 南京馬步軍都指揮使司.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 南京馬步軍都指揮使司。

decisions.reason: 控制諸國 means the offices controlled the various states, not ‘frontier peoples’; 諸國 is not 諸部 or 諸夷.

decisions.after: North Zubu, Northwest Zubu, Qisu River, and Chengqu Li State Great King Offices
decisions.reason: The original wrongly attaches 阻卜 to 城屈裏國大王府, which has none. The proposal correctly drops Zubu from Chengqu Li but also strips it from 北阻卜 and 西北阻卜; those first two offices must keep Zubu.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 北阻卜國大王府西北阻卜國大王府乞粟河國大王府城屈裏國大王府

decisions.reason: 當部人內選授 is the Huali request to appoint xiangwen from their own people; 不許 is the separate court refusal, not part of what was requested.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 劃離部請今後詳穩於當部人內選授，不許。

value.action: pressed the same agricultural and craft priorities as Nieli
was especially earnest about farming and crafts

claimRevisions.reason: The repaired English restores 太祖尤拳拳焉 as especial earnestness about farming and crafts; the extracted action ‘pressed the same priorities’ was an understatement created by the rejected idiomatic wording.
